title: Bank account
description: One active Kartellbank account the member may view in the Basetool, with its balance, target and 30-day trend, and the two facts about the member: whether they may raise a withdrawal or transfer here and their own limit. No holders, custody, limit tables or ceilings. Foreign bank data: a client keeps it in memory only, for at most 7 days.

accountId.description: Opaque identifier issued by the Basetool. Clients store and echo it, never parse it.

accountNo.description: The account number the Basetool shows, such as KB-0042.

type.description: An org unit's, an area's, the KRT, the bank's own or a special account.

orgUnit.description: The org unit that owns the account; null for an account without one.

balance.description: The current balance in whole aUEC.

balanceTarget.description: The balance goal in whole aUEC; null when none is set.

delta30d.description: The net change over the last 30 days in whole aUEC.

sparkline.description: The end-of-day balances of the last 30 days in whole aUEC, oldest first, ending with the current balance.

requestable.description: Whether the member may raise a withdrawal or transfer from this account.

ownLimit.description: The member's limit in whole aUEC above which a request needs an approval; null when none applies.
